date-tvdb.reason: AniDB S1 "Special" (mirror date 2014-01-03) lands by default on TVDB S0E1 "Strange+ Special" (2014-04-18), the only TVDB special. The titles are the same word and there is one special on each side. MAL 23679 "Strange+ Special" is the unaired episode (a 3-minute episode 13) shipped on the first season's Blu-ray/DVD, aired 2014-04-18, and ANN reported the Strange+ BD including an unaired episode (2014-03-28). That matches the TVDB entry in name and date. The AniDB mirror date of 2014-01-03 is the odd one out (it falls before the premiere), which is why confidence is medium and not high. The 12 regular episodes match S1E1-12 title for title.
